name: @mcp-consultant-tools/sharepoint

tools.name: spo-authenticate
tools.description: Sign in to SharePoint as yourself (device code). Returns a URL and a code; open the URL, enter the code and sign in. Sign-in completes in the background, and the sign-in is shared with the CLI. Only needed when no client secret is configured.

tools.name: spo-auth-status
tools.description: Show the SharePoint sign-in state, the signed-in account, the delegated permissions the sign-in carries, and whether they cover reading and writing.

tools.name: spo-logout
tools.description: Sign out of SharePoint and delete the cached sign-in (device-code mode). The CLI is signed out too.

tools.name: spo-search-files
tools.description: Search every SharePoint site, OneDrive and Teams file you can open (Microsoft Search, sign-in mode). Returns name, location, web URL, last modified, drive and item ids (usable with spo-download-file) and the hit summary. Supports KQL, for example: budget filetype:xlsx, or "project plan" author:"Jane Doe".

tools.name: spo-resolve-link
tools.description: Turn any SharePoint or OneDrive URL, including a sharing link, into a file or folder record with its drive and item ids, so the other tools can act on a pasted link (sign-in mode).

url.description: Full https:// SharePoint or OneDrive URL or sharing link

tools.name: spo-find-sites
tools.description: Find SharePoint sites by keyword, or resolve one site from its URL (sign-in mode). The returned webUrl can be passed as siteId to the other tools.

query.description: Keyword, or a site URL such as https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/example

tools.name: spo-get-my-drive
tools.description: Get your own OneDrive (sign-in mode): drive id, web URL, owner and storage quota. Pass the returned driveId as driveId, and siteUrl as siteId, to spo-get-item, spo-download-file and the other item tools.

tools.name: spo-list-my-drive
tools.description: List the files and folders in your own OneDrive (sign-in mode): the root, or a folder by path such as Documents/Reports.

path.description: Folder path from the OneDrive root, for example 'Documents/Reports'. Omit or '/' for the root.

tools.name: spo-list-sites
tools.description: List all configured SharePoint sites (active and inactive)

tools.name: spo-get-site-info
tools.description: Get detailed site information including metadata, created/modified dates, and owner info

siteId.description:
Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL (use spo-list-sites to find IDs)

Examples:
  - Named site: `intranet`
  - Default site: `default`
  - Project site: `project-alpha`
  - Site URL (sign-in mode): `https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/example`

tools.name: spo-test-connection
tools.description: Test connectivity to a SharePoint site and verify permissions (Sites.Read.All and Files.Read.All required)

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

tools.name: spo-list-drives
tools.description: List all document libraries (drives) in a SharePoint site with metadata

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

tools.name: spo-get-drive-info
tools.description: Get detailed document library information including quota, owner, and created/modified dates

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

driveId.description:
Drive ID (use spo-list-drives to find IDs)

Examples:
  - Drive GUID: `b!abc123...`

tools.name: spo-clear-cache
tools.description: Clear cached SharePoint responses (useful after site changes or for troubleshooting)

siteId.description: Clear cache for specific site only (optional)

pattern.description: Clear only cache entries matching this pattern (optional)

tools.name: spo-list-items
tools.description: List all files and folders in a document library or folder

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

tools.name: spo-get-item
tools.description: Get detailed file or folder metadata by ID

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

tools.name: spo-get-item-by-path
tools.description: Get file or folder metadata by path (relative to drive root)

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

path.description:
Item path relative to drive root

Examples:
  - Root file: `/Report.xlsx`
  - Nested file: `/Projects/2024/proposal.docx`
  - Folder path: `/Shared Documents/Archive`

tools.name: spo-search-items
tools.description: Search for files by filename or metadata (filename and metadata search only, not full-text)

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

limit.description: Maximum results (default: 100, max configured in SHAREPOINT_MAX_SEARCH_RESULTS)

tools.name: spo-get-recent-items
tools.description: Get recently modified items in a document library

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

tools.name: spo-get-folder-structure
tools.description: Get recursive folder tree structure (useful for understanding site organization)

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

folderId.description: Root folder ID (optional, defaults to drive root)

tools.name: spo-get-crm-doc-locs
tools.description: Get SharePoint document locations configured in PowerPlatform Dataverse (sharepointdocumentlocation entity)

tools.name: spo-validate-doc-loc
tools.description: Validate that a PowerPlatform document location configuration matches the actual SharePoint site structure. Checks site accessibility, folder existence, and file counts. Returns validation status (valid/warning/error) with issues and recommendations.

documentLocationId.description: GUID of the sharepointdocumentlocation record in PowerPlatform

tools.name: spo-verify-doc-mig
tools.description: Verify that documents were successfully migrated from source to target SharePoint folder. Compares file counts, sizes, names, and modified dates. Returns migration status (complete/incomplete/failed) with success rate and detailed comparison.

tools.name: spo-download-file
tools.description: Download file content from SharePoint. Text files (json, csv, txt, xml, etc.) returned as UTF-8 string. Binary files (docx, pdf, xlsx, etc.) returned as base64-encoded string. Use itemId or path to identify the file.

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

itemId.description: Item ID (use this OR path, not both)

path.description:
File path relative to drive root (use this OR itemId, not both)

Examples:
  - Root file: `/Report.xlsx`
  - Nested file: `/Projects/2024/proposal.docx`
  - Folder path: `/Shared Documents/Archive`

saveToDisk.description: Save the file to SHAREPOINT_DOWNLOAD_DIR (default ~/Downloads/mcp-sharepoint) and return its absolute path instead of the content

convertToPdf.description: Return a PDF rendering of a Word, PowerPoint or Excel file, so it can be read without an Office parser

tools.name: spo-upload-file
tools.description: Upload a file to a SharePoint document library. Requires SHAREPOINT_ENABLE_WRITE=true. Give content (text as 'utf-8', the default, or binary as 'base64') OR localPath, a file inside your home folder that is read from disk so its content never passes through the conversation (use this for Office files built locally). Hidden folders and credential-shaped files are refused. Files up to SHAREPOINT_MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB (default 100MB) are supported.

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

path.description:
Target file path relative to drive root (including filename)

Examples:
  - Root upload: `/NewFile.txt`
  - Subfolder upload: `/Reports/Q1/summary.csv`

content.description: File content (text string or base64-encoded binary). Use this OR localPath

localPath.description: Path of a local file inside your home folder, such as ~/Documents/model.xlsx. Use this OR content

encoding.description: Content encoding: 'utf-8' for text (default), 'base64' for binary

overwrite.description: Overwrite if file exists (default: false, will fail if file exists)

tools.name: spo-create-folder
tools.description: Create a new folder in a SharePoint document library. Requires SHAREPOINT_ENABLE_WRITE=true.

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

parentPath.description:
Parent folder path (use '/' for drive root)

Examples:
  - Drive root: `/`
  - Subfolder: `/Projects/2024`

folderName.description:
Name for the new folder

Examples:
  - Simple folder: `Archive`
  - Dated folder: `2024-Q1-Reports`

tools.name: spo-delete-item
tools.description: Delete a file or folder from SharePoint. Requires SHAREPOINT_ENABLE_DELETE=true AND confirm=true. This action is IRREVERSIBLE - the item is moved to the site recycle bin.

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

itemId.description: ID of the file or folder to delete

confirm.description: Must be set to true to confirm deletion. Safety mechanism to prevent accidental deletions.

tools.name: spo-move-item
tools.description: Move a file or folder to a new location within or across document libraries. Requires SHAREPOINT_ENABLE_WRITE=true.

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

itemId.description: ID of the file or folder to move

targetDriveId.description: Target drive ID (can be same as source for moves within a library)

targetParentPath.description:
Target parent folder path in the target drive

Examples:
  - Drive root: `/`
  - Subfolder: `/Archive/2024`

tools.name: spo-copy-item
tools.description: Copy a file or folder to a new location. Requires SHAREPOINT_ENABLE_WRITE=true. Copy is asynchronous - the operation may take a moment to complete for large files.

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

itemId.description: ID of the file or folder to copy

targetParentPath.description:
Target parent folder path in the target drive

Examples:
  - Drive root: `/`
  - Subfolder: `/Backup/Latest`

newName.description: Optional new name for the copy (defaults to original name)

tools.name: spo-rename-item
tools.description: Rename a file or folder in SharePoint. Requires SHAREPOINT_ENABLE_WRITE=true.

siteId.description: Site ID from configuration, or (sign-in mode) a full site URL

itemId.description: ID of the file or folder to rename

newName.description: New name for the file or folder (include file extension for files)

tools.name: spo-read-text
tools.description: Read a text file (.txt, .md, .csv, .json, .xml, .yaml, .html) as UTF-8, with the eTag spo-write-text needs. Nothing is saved to disk. Off when SHAREPOINT_CONTENT_READ excludes the format.

url.description: SharePoint or OneDrive link to the file, including a sharing link (sign-in mode). Use this OR driveId and itemId.

tools.name: spo-write-text
tools.description: Replace the whole content of an existing text file. Pass the eTag from spo-read-text. Saves a new version of the same file (see its version history to roll back), and refuses if the file changed since it was read. Off unless SHAREPOINT_CONTENT_WRITE includes the format.

url.description: SharePoint or OneDrive link to the file, including a sharing link (sign-in mode). Use this OR driveId and itemId.

tools.name: spo-read-excel
tools.description: Read an Excel workbook on the server, without downloading it. Without worksheet: list the worksheets with their used ranges. With worksheet: values, displayed text and formulas for range (such as A1:D20), or for the used range when range is left out. Off when SHAREPOINT_CONTENT_READ excludes excel.

url.description: SharePoint or OneDrive link to the file, including a sharing link (sign-in mode). Use this OR driveId and itemId.

worksheet.description: Worksheet name; leave out to list the worksheets

range.description: A1 range such as A1:D20; leave out for the used range

tools.name: spo-write-excel
tools.description: Set values or formulas on a range of an Excel workbook, on the server, so co-authors see it as it happens. Give values or formulas as rows, matching the range: A1:B2 takes [[1, 2], [3, 4]]. Formulas start with =. Off unless SHAREPOINT_CONTENT_WRITE includes excel.

url.description: SharePoint or OneDrive link to the file, including a sharing link (sign-in mode). Use this OR driveId and itemId.

range.description: A1 range such as B2 or A1:C3

values.description: Values, one inner array per row

formulas.description: Formulas, one inner array per row

tools.name: spo-read-word
tools.description: Read a Word document (.docx) as Markdown: headings as #, list items as -, tables as Markdown tables. Each paragraph or table starts with its anchor, such as [p12], which spo-edit-word uses. Returns the eTag spo-edit-word needs. Nothing is saved to disk. Off when SHAREPOINT_CONTENT_READ excludes the format.

url.description: SharePoint or OneDrive link to the file, including a sharing link (sign-in mode). Use this OR driveId and itemId.

tools.name: spo-edit-word
tools.description: Edit a Word document with a list of operations, applied in order, all or none. Anchors refer to the numbering from spo-read-word, even after earlier operations in the same call. Formatting outside the edited text is kept; a replacement across differently formatted runs takes the first run's formatting, and the result says so. Saves a new version of the same file (see its version history to roll back), and refuses if the file changed since it was read. Off unless SHAREPOINT_CONTENT_WRITE includes the format.

url.description: SharePoint or OneDrive link to the file, including a sharing link (sign-in mode). Use this OR driveId and itemId.

text.description: replace: the text to find. insert and append: the new paragraph text (a newline starts another paragraph)

all.description: replace: replace every match; without it a text found in more than one place is refused

anchor.description: insertAfter, insertBefore, delete: the block anchor from spo-read-word, such as p12

style.description: insert and append: paragraph style ID such as Heading2 or ListBullet; leave out for Normal

tools.name: spo-read-powerpoint
tools.description: Read a PowerPoint deck (.pptx): for each slide, its title, the other text on it, and its speaker notes. Returns the eTag spo-edit-powerpoint needs. Nothing is saved to disk. Off when SHAREPOINT_CONTENT_READ excludes the format.

url.description: SharePoint or OneDrive link to the file, including a sharing link (sign-in mode). Use this OR driveId and itemId.

tools.name: spo-edit-powerpoint
tools.description: Replace text on the slides and in the speaker notes of a PowerPoint deck, all replacements or none. Formatting outside the edited text is kept; a replacement across differently formatted runs takes the first run's formatting, and the result says so. Saves a new version of the same file (see its version history to roll back), and refuses if the file changed since it was read. Off unless SHAREPOINT_CONTENT_WRITE includes the format.

url.description: SharePoint or OneDrive link to the file, including a sharing link (sign-in mode). Use this OR driveId and itemId.

slide.description: Limit to this slide number (its notes included)

all.description: Replace every match; without it a text found in more than one place is refused

tools.name: spo-create-file
tools.description: Create a new file: a blank Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx) or PowerPoint (.pptx) file, or a text file (.md, .txt, .csv, .json and similar) with the content given. Never replaces an existing file. Fill a new Office file in with spo-edit-word, spo-write-excel or spo-edit-powerpoint; for a richly formatted file, build it locally and use spo-upload-file with localPath. Off unless SHAREPOINT_CONTENT_WRITE includes the format.

folderUrl.description: SharePoint or OneDrive link to the folder (sign-in mode). Use this OR driveId with folderPath.

folderPath.description: Folder path from the drive root, such as /Reports/2026; leave out for the root

fileName.description: New file name with extension, such as Plan.docx or notes.md
